name: SCGBHD
recent: Southern Cable Group Berhad 近期持续出现雇员公积金局（EPF）的股东权益变动申报，同时因凭单转换而多次发行新股。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收与净利分别同比增长25.8%和28.2%。
notable: 雇员公积金局（EPF）在2026年10月至11月期间多次申报股东权益变动。
公司因凭单转换为普通股而多次发行新股，涉及2026年10月27日、11月11日及11月23日上市的新股。
risks: 雇员公积金局（EPF）在2026年10月至11月期间多次申报股东权益变动，显示大股东持股出现变动。
凭单转换导致新股发行，可能对现有股东持股造成摊薄。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为RM527.6百万，净利为RM40.6百万，净利率7.7%；营收环比增长21.9%，净利环比增长22.3%；营收同比增长25.8%，净利同比增长28.2%。

recent_en: Southern Cable Group Berhad has recently seen continuous changes in substantial shareholder interest by the Employees Provident Fund Board, along with multiple new share issuances from warrant conversions. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue and net profit grew 25.8% and 28.2% year-on-year respectively.
notable_en: The Employees Provident Fund Board (EPF) filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interest between October and November 2026.
The company issued new shares multiple times due to conversion of warrants to ordinary shares, with new shares listed on 27 October, 11 November and 23 November 2026.
risks_en: The Employees Provident Fund Board (EPF) filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interest between October and November 2026, indicating changes in major shareholder holdings.
Warrant conversions led to new share issuances, which may dilute existing shareholders' stakes.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM527.6 million and net profit was RM40.6 million, with a net margin of 7.7%; revenue grew 21.9% QoQ and net profit 22.3% QoQ; revenue grew 25.8% YoY and net profit 28.2% YoY.
